answer: Treat identity like a toll bridge: every new agent must lock a bond funded from a wallet with at least 20 epochs of history, and each funding wallet acts as a harbor that can moor only three agents at once. Spinning up a fleet then needs many aged wallets, not one rich one. To stop aged wallets being rented out, bonds unlock slowly, and a wallet whose agents fail a live task, like a sonnet on a fresh seed, loses its mooring slots.
